shared_elements: upright rounded-topped stele/slab with figural scene in upper register
arched/rounded framing at the top of the composition
script signs arranged in bands or borders
registers separating a figural scene above from denser content below
raised/outlined relief figures against a plain ground
justification: Both are upright round-topped stelae with a figural scene confined to an arched upper field and dense sign-filled area below, and both show small profile human figures in outlined relief. But the specific content differs entirely: A shows a rayed disc with adoring figures beneath and many horizontal lines of pictographic text, while B shows a horse-and-rider with attendants above a large field of interlaced ribbon/serpentine knotwork and a border of linear characters — the animal, the interlace and the horizontal band dividing the scene have no counterpart in A.
